messages:
maria: Heads-up — we got a customer report that their org quota dropped unexpectedly after a flurry of tool calls yesterday. Looks like retries + toolcall tokens are being double-counted in some paths.
joel: Ugh. Which path? Is this for retry on tool failures or user-triggered retries?
suresh: From the logs I sampled it's the automated retry loop when a tool webhooks 502s. The middleware increments prompt tokens, then the toolcall handler also adds the tool tokens again on retry.
maria: Exact TL;DR: one request -> initial prompt (X tokens) + tool call (Y tokens). Retry triggers another completion attempt that re-attributes prompt tokens instead of attributing only the extra completion/tool tokens.
joel: Can you paste the small trace?
suresh: sure — here's the simplified extractor: ```
// pseudocode
record_usage(org, key, prompt_tokens)
call_tool()
if tool_failed {
  retry_completion()
  record_usage(org, key, prompt_tokens) // <-- oops
}
```
maria: Also saw this in quota lag dashboard: org "heimdall" used 3x expected tokens during the outage window. Billing alarm didn't fire because per-key burn was under threshold; per-org hit the cap.
alana: So two problems: (1) accounting double-count on retry, (2) console UX only surfaces per-key and global quotas, not per-org burst anomalies well. We should prob add a per-org spike alert.
billing-bot: FYI — this will affect monthly invoicing if not adjusted. We can do a credit for the hour but want a root cause fix.
joel: For the fix: make record_usage idempotent for a request_id and also split attribution: prompt_tokens should only be attributed once per request_id; completion/tool tokens can be additive on retries. That avoids losing tokens when we legitimately retry completions.
suresh: Agree. We have request_id on each incoming API call but downstream tool calls spin new child request_ids. Need a stable parent_id through retries.
alana: Devex: can we expose this in the console so customers see "tokens attributed to retries" or a broken-down timeline? Even a simple chart per minute showing prompt vs completion vs tool tokens would help.
devex: Yep — small UX change: add a toggle "show attributed_by_event (prompt, completion, tool, retry)" to the token timeline. Also add a hover tooltip that explains idempotent attribution.
maria: Operationally, we should patch the middleware ASAP to prevent immediate re-billing. Make the middleware check an in-flight set for parent_request_id and suppress recording prompt_tokens on a retry.
joel: I'll own the server patch. Suresh, can you add a unit test that simulates a tool failure + retry and asserts usage counters?
suresh: On it. Also proposing a background job to scan last 24h for unusual prompt/completion ratios > 2:1 and alert eng-platform.
onana: (random typo message)
maria: Haha :) ignore.
billing-bot: After patch we should run a dry-run reconciliation: compute what the corrected counters would be and put them in a reconciliation dashboard for the billing ops team.
joel: Timeline: patch in canary today, rollout to prod tomorrow. Devex and billing — will you validate the reconciled numbers and propose credit adjustments if necessary?
devex: Yes, we'll generate a short report and surface to CS.
maria: For product: document the behavior: "Retries may re-credit completion/tool tokens; prompt tokens are single-attribution per request_id" — also add to API docs runtime guarantees.
suresh: One more gotcha — toolcall streaming vs non-streaming had slightly different code paths for attribution. I'll normalize to use the same parent_request_id logic across both.
joel: Perfect. Thanks team. I'll open PR and tag @suresh @alana @devex @billing-bot. :thumbsup:
